question: Should OpenClaw retire `coalesceSameSenderDms` now and make `imsg` 0.11.1 a hard iMessage startup floor, accepting doctor and binary-upgrade actions for existing users?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility-policy decision: tests can verify the migration and version check, but they cannot decide whether existing persisted config and older binaries should fail closed during upgrade.

options.title: Approve after current-head proof
options.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after macOS evidence covers doctor migration, old-version recovery messaging, and successful one-turn split-send delivery on the current head.

options.title: Defer the retirement
options.body: Keep the current config and client-side fallback until maintainers are ready to require the binary and config upgrades together.

recommendation.title: Approve after current-head proof
recommendation.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after macOS evidence covers doctor migration, old-version recovery messaging, and successful one-turn split-send delivery on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily concerns the supported `imsg` release floor and operator upgrade policy around that dependency.
